predictionTask: At a fixed decision close, classify price movement over the NEXT FIVE TRADING SESSIONS as UP (>0) or DOWN (<=0).
explanation: ALL inputs and all mock predictions are synthetic simulation; no real Jev/Laya integration, no real stocks, no live trading. One fixed synthetic symbol and entire 32-period sequence; 5 non-overlapping trading sessions per label. Train/validation outcomes obey purge/embargo. Every signal is decided on the previous trading session's close, strictly before execution time. No tuning from future held-out returns. Single/second are fixed momentum heuristics, fusion requires agreement and may abstain; none is an empirically trained AI model. Buy-hold holds continuously only over contiguous held-out intervals and pays just one open/close. Other strategies close each 5-session position and pay both sides. Random shares full exposure and case pool with single/buy-hold, but fusion can abstain: exposure differences must not be misread as strategy skill. Wilson95 is a descriptive IID binomial approximation, not valid coverage for correlated time-series labels. 252/5 annualization is illustrative; no statistically established edge, no survivorship representativeness of real stock universes.
